protocol: RDE-PPI three-fold complex split, seed 2022, single mutations
selection_policy: Evaluate candidates in the declared order and accept the first candidate passing every threshold. No prediction-dependent weights or hyperparameters are permitted.

candidates.name: ProFE-Net
candidates.description: Manuscript-faithful frozen EnhancedRDE backbone with trainable residue/pair encoders, mutation embedding, geometric attention, global-max difference readout, and strict antisymmetry.

candidates.name: ProFE-RDE-baseline
candidates.description: Same downstream transfer head using a locally self-trained official RDE backbone.

candidates.name: ProFE-fixed-equal-ensemble
candidates.description: Prediction-independent arithmetic mean fixed before either outer prediction is generated.

supplement.name: ProFE-Net-PDB5
supplement.description: Balanced PDB-disjoint five-fold evaluation reported separately for all, single, and multiple mutations; it is not compared directly with the copied three-fold baselines.
